title: WooCommerce Audit
meta: A clear review of your WooCommerce store with a prioritized fix list and an optional 1-on-1 call. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WooCommerce audit with a prioritized fix list
overview: We review your WooCommerce store from the shopper's side and the technical side. We check speed, checkout steps, product pages, plugins, security settings, search basics and tracking. You get a written report that ranks each finding by importance, says why it matters and explains how to fix it. Standard and Premium add a video call where we walk through the report and answer your questions.

pkgs.blurb: A health check of speed, checkout and plugins with ranked fixes.
Adds a security and product page review plus a call.
A deeper review with tracking checks, a roadmap and a re-check.

faq: Do you change anything in my store?
No. An audit is read-only. You get a report and decide what to act on. If you want the fixes made, we quote them as a separate order in writing.
What do you need for the audit?
Your store link, and for deeper checks a shop manager or administrator user created for us. We never need your passwords and you can remove us after the audit.
Will you place orders in my live store?
Only if you agree, and we refund them straight away. We can also walk through checkout up to the payment step and test payment on a staging copy instead.
Does the audit cover legal pages?
We check that privacy, returns and terms pages exist and are easy to find. We do not give legal advice, so ask a professional to review the wording.
